function.name: run_test_suite
function.description: Execute a test suite or a standalone test script safely inside the sandbox. Captures traceback and stderr on failure so you can fix errors and retry (TDD loop). Features an automatic max-retry interrupt to hand control back to human if tests fail continuously.

test_target.description: Workspace-relative test file or project directory, e.g. 'tests/test_math.py', 'hello/main_test.go', or 'hello' containing go.mod. Go file targets run the package tree containing the file.

framework.description: Default auto detects Go from .go targets or go.mod directories; otherwise uses pytest. Go runs go test -json ./... and verifies passing test cases. Python scripts alone do not prove collected tests.
